text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen has finally arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер appears more upbeat
than before
as she exits the waiting
room, fully prepared to
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Determined to walk her own path, Grass
Wonder
heads for the track, where her
formidable
opponent Спешл Уик
awaits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
